caption: The drawing depicts a botanical illustration of a branch with distinctive lobed leaves. The branch is brown with white sections that follow a geometric, banded pattern along its length and smaller offshoots. Attached to the branch are seven green leaves, each featuring deep, irregular lobes with pointed tips. The background within the square border of the illustration is a light beige color, while the larger page surrounding the illustration is off-white. There is a handwritten label at the top of the bordered area, and the entire illustration is framed by a thin brown line.
title: Autograph Quilt
